education.degree: Bachelor’s in Computer Science and Systems Engineering

highlights: Developed and maintained Service Catalogs using Flow Designer, implementing end-to-end fulfillment processes based on business requirements.
Configured custom tables, forms, and lists to meet functional and business requirements .
Developed and configured Business Rules, Client Scripts, Catalog Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, and UI Actions to implement business logic and enhance platform functionality.
Built and customized Service Portal components, including Pages and Widgets, to enhance user experience.
Worked extensively with Service Operations Workspace (SOW) and UI Builder to enhance workspace functionality and user experience, implementing ’My Approvals’ page for end-user approval management.
Designed and configured Database Views by joining custom and out-of-box tables (Approvals, Requested Items, Service Agreements) to consolidate workspace information .
Developed and configured Transform Maps using Data Sources to support data migration and record management.
Utilized System Dependency checks to identify potential downstream impacts of table and field changes, documenting impacts and updating dependency comments.
Developed and maintained Service Catalog Items and Record Producers using Workflows and Flow Designers.
Implemented third-party integrations using Flow Designer triggered on Catalog Item creation to update corresponding records.
Created Inbound Email flows, Scheduled Jobs, Dashboards, and Reports.
Developed Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Actions, and UI Policies using JavaScript.
Managed multiple modules including Major Incident Management, Service Operations Workspace Universal Request, and basic HRSD.
Created and managed Update Sets to move customizations seamlessly between systems .
